test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If 'P + Q' means 'Q is the mother of P', 'P - Q' means 'Q is the brother of P', 'P % Q' means 'Q is the father of P' and 'P × Q' means 'Q is the sister of P', which of the following options shows that 'L is the maternal uncle of K'?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbol,

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

Let decode the given mathematical sign:

 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 %
 × 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
mother

 
 
 
brother

 
 father

 
 sister
 
 

Option 1) K - M + N × L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad6e3c1ccba166625c236b80725d9a71bb892d06e3e289af1c7a1687a856cec.png] 

Here, L is maternal aunt of K.

Option 2) L - N + M × K

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b3946df74ebd3c0c056e5582706165e92e52982b91c161457171ea25e770343.png] 

Here, gender of L is not clear.

Option 3) K + S × N - L

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f143d862c0a162f095b54418ecc53718477df1b60360bc9d660bf39324570201.png] 

Here, L is maternal uncle of K.

Option 4) L - S % K + N

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d012166c7df2dee0f4c3d91cb87e99fed5df2fb55d04bc3a03f507c12dbbf4e3.png] 

Here, gender of L is not clear. 

Hence, the correct answer is "K + S × **N - L".**
